title: Inception says Mercury 3 generates over 1,000 tokens a second
script:
Inception released Mercury 3, an AI model that hits a massive speed milestone.
It generates over one thousand tokens every single second.
The architecture relies on a diffusion-based text generation approach to process text much faster.
Most standard models crawl along at a fraction of this output rate.
This breakthrough eliminates major latency bottlenecks for heavy enterprise workloads.
Developers can now build real-time conversational agents without annoying lag times.
Would you switch to an application running on Mercury 3?
